name: influencer.profile_set
description: Records one read of a saved collaborator's Instagram account: its display name (kept only where the account has none yet: a name a person gave stays), the address influencer.profile_file answered for its picture, and its followers (each null: the one kept stays). Keeps only the address's path on the core. Internal.
sql:
insert into brandbase.account_profiles as p (org_id, handle, name, followers, read_at) values (:org, :handle, nullif(btrim(:name::text), ''), :followers::bigint, :now::timestamptz)
on conflict (org_id, handle) do update set
  name = coalesce(p.name, excluded.name),
  followers = coalesce(excluded.followers, p.followers),
  picture = case when p.picture_key is not null and right(:src::text, length(p.picture_key) + 1) = '/' || p.picture_key then coalesce(substring(:src::text from '/files/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}/brandbase/[0-9a-f-]{36}\.(?:jpg|png|webp)$'), p.picture) else p.picture end,
  read_at = excluded.read_at
returning jsonb_build_object('handle', p.handle, 'name', p.name, 'picture', p.picture, 'followers', p.followers) as result
